title: Selectively visible lights over valley on Highway 40
place_text: Highway 40 en route to Bullhead City, Arizona

tellings.quote: Another time, um, my son and I were, uh, driving to our old vacation place in Bullhead City, Arizona, and we were on Highway 40, out in a remote area, and, um, I saw this, uh, this bright white light hovering over this valley about 5 or 10 miles away.

plain: A bright white light hovered over a valley 5 or 10 miles away while a scientist named Steve Colbern drove with his son on Highway 40 toward their old vacation place in Bullhead City, Arizona, in a remote area. Colbern, who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, tells this as something he saw himself, and he also names someone called Garrett. The story's point is that the lights seemed visible only to some people, not to everyone.
